feasibility_reasoning:
The mechanism works. M1 is tracked in commit 30c49a6. lighthouse-local.mjs defaults to transport h2 (:90,125) and warmUa browser (:135), and runs are interleaved (:356-358). summary.json records transport and warmUa (:383-397, written at :497). The readiness probe hits /robots.txt (artifactServer.ts:57) with a browser UA (:126), and warmDocument also uses a browser UA (:589-599). F1 holds in code: the old readiness probe is a bare `curl -sf` with Accept */*, so homepageLangMiddleware (src/start.ts:139) lets it through. br-proxy rewrites the host to 127.0.0.1:$UP, so the curl render and the browser requests land on the same cache key host::path (src/lib/http/documentCache.ts:225). format:check passes on EVIDENCE.md and README.md.

The scope is wrong in four ways:
(1) Agents actually run $SCRATCH/lh/measure-local.sh and $SCRATCH/lh/measure-ab.sh, which are byte-identical to narzedzia/*-cloud.sh. Marking the repo copies deprecated changes nothing. The levers that work are EVIDENCE.md:16 plus an exit-1 stub in the scratch copies.
(2) Phase-1 verification fields outside M3's file list still prescribe the old harness: boot-js.json:170, boot-js.md:343, lighthouse-analyst.json:110, prior-art.json:175 and README.md:7.
(3) The saved production ground truth is the buffered shape. psi/home.html has 15 <script>, close to baseline2-home.html (14) and far from the browser-warm home-A.html (34). Until M4 lands, PSI can get either variant, so measuring only the browser variant does not give production parity for changes that alter the document's shape.
(4) The verification only checks labels. It should also assert the streaming body (391 114 B vs 382 468 B) and x-nes-cache=HIT.
blocking_issues: Editing the narzedzia/*.sh copies does not retire the harness. The scripts agents actually run are $SCRATCH/lh/measure-local.sh and measure-ab.sh (identical, diff=0). Stub them (exit 1, pointing to lighthouse-local.mjs) and edit EVIDENCE.md:16.

Re-point the verification fields that still cite the old harness: faza1/raporty/boot-js.json:170, boot-js.md:343, lighthouse-analyst.json:110, prior-art.json:175, README.md:7 (and their scratch copies).

Do not make warmUa=browser the only arm. The production sample psi/home.html is buffered-shape (15 scripts, like the bot variant), so until M4 lands, changes to document shape (barrier, streaming, dehydration, preloads) should also run --warm-ua bot.
The verification should assert the measured body (home*.html raw ~391 114 B, x-nes-cache=HIT) and list per-run FCP, not only the summary.json labels.
effect_reasoning:
This is measurement work, so it adds 0 score points directly. The attribution of the baseline2 gap to 'bot variant + h1' is not supported.

Per-run mobile FCP/LCP (ms):
- baseline2 (h1, bot variant): 5045/5582, 4983/5531, 4928/5635.
- browser-warm h1 (ab-h1-h2 A): 2993/4018, 4074/5120, 4998/5545.

Run A-mobile-3, which is the browser variant, matches baseline2 within 20-90 ms. So the 4.98 -> 4.06 s FCP gap is the Lantern FCP-mode race (F4: about 1.1 s per mode on 1.6 Mb/s, set by whether the High-priority scripts land in the FCP graph). It is not the bot variant, which differs by only 8.6 KB raw.

The only piece established by A/B is h1 -> h2: mobile LCP -0.30 s (FCP 0.00), desktop FCP -0.28 s and LCP -0.30 s, desktop perf 95 -> 98.

measure-ab.sh was already interleaved, so its deltas were comparable with each other. The real risk was narrower:
- h1's 6 connections per origin hide LCP-image contention, so preload and priority changes were under-read by up to about 0.3 s of LCP.
- Changes that only affect streaming were measured on a document without the stream.

A larger comparability hazard is taking the median of n=3 runs over a bimodal/trimodal FCP. Phase-2 FCP and score claims need n>=5 and a per-run mode listing.
corrected_estimate: 0 direct score points. Prevents mis-reading about 0.30 s of LCP (mobile and desktop) and about 0.28 s of desktop FCP (about 3 desktop perf points) in deltas for preload and priority changes. It does not account for or remove the roughly 0.9 s mobile FCP gap between baseline2 and the new baseline, which is FCP-mode noise (h1 browser-warm run: 4998/5545 ms, the same as baseline2). It is S effort if done as: an EVIDENCE §0-cloud edit, exit-1 stubs in the $SCRATCH/lh copies, re-pointing the 4-5 verification fields, a second --warm-ua bot arm for document-shape changes, and n>=5 runs for FCP/score.
better_alternative: Cheaper and equally effective: replace $SCRATCH/lh/measure-local.sh and measure-ab.sh with stubs that print the lighthouse-local.mjs command and exit 1, edit only EVIDENCE.md:16, and sed the verification fields in the phase-1 JSON/MD reports. Leave the narzedzia/*.sh copies as an archive with a one-line header. Make phase-2 verification read home*.html size / x-nes-cache and per-run FCP from summary.json rather than only the transport/warmUa labels.
